verdict.rationale: Sunbiz's own pages list 'Online Filing' for LLC Articles of Organization and for profit and non-profit Articles of Incorporation. The annual-report e-file page documents online credit/debit card payment with immediate processing and says a typed signature is legally sufficient, so the core formation and filing transactions can be completed online. The probe only covers robots.txt on the e-file host (nothing else on that host was fetched), so it is not a hands-on failure of the filing flow and does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end online formation, and explicit documentation of online payment for formation filings (card payment is documented only for annual reports).
